full_prompt_en: A square Renaissance-style oil portrait shows a young noblewoman from the waist up against a deep, nearly black green background. She stands slightly left of center, shoulders turned to the right while her head faces the viewer directly. Her fair face is calmly lit, with a small closed mouth, light brown eyes, and smooth cheeks modeled in delicate warm and cool transitions. Dark hair is pulled tightly away from the face and rises into an ornate rounded headpiece dotted with pearls and warm jewel-like beads. The high neckline is edged in pale lace and fine gold trim, leading into a richly patterned violet-blue bodice. Intricate gold embroidery runs vertically down the center and curls across the sleeves and chest in fine vegetal patterns. The shoulders are broad and rounded, built from puffed sleeves whose sheen and dense needlework give the clothing more weight than the simple background. A small hanging ornament or earring glints near the visible ear. The hands fall outside the frame, keeping attention on face, headpiece, and fabric. Soft light enters from the upper left, brightening the forehead, nose, and one side of the brocade while the opposite sleeve turns into deep indigo shadow. The background remains unarticulated, so no architecture or props distract from the precise controlled pose. The oil surface is smooth and carefully layered, with the textile details sharper than the dark ground. The overall composition is formal and balanced, combining quiet expression with luxurious color, gold linework, and a restrained courtly stillness.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形文艺复兴式油画半身肖像描绘年轻贵族女子立于深而近黑的绿背景前。她站在中央偏左，肩膀朝右，头却正对观者。浅色面孔受到平静照明，嘴轻闭，眼睛浅棕，平滑脸颊由细腻冷暖过渡塑形。深发紧紧从脸上拢开，向上收进缀着珍珠和暖色宝石般珠子的华丽圆顶头冠。高领边饰浅蕾丝与细金边，向下接续图案繁复的紫蓝色胸衣。细密金色刺绣沿中央竖行，又以植物般曲纹绕过袖子和胸前。肩膀宽而圆，由泡起的袖子构成，其光泽与密集针线让服装比简朴背景更有重量。可见耳边一枚小吊饰或耳环闪着亮光。双手落在画框之外，让注意力集中在脸、头冠与织物。柔光从左上进入，照亮额头、鼻子与织锦一侧，对侧袖子转入深靛蓝阴影。背景没有具体陈设，因此没有建筑或道具分散精确而受控的姿势。油画表面平滑且层层细绘，纺织物细节比暗背景更锐利。整体构图正式且平衡，以安静神情结合奢华色彩、金线和克制的宫廷静止感。
style_prompt_en: The image has a meticulous old-master oil-paint finish, with smoothly modeled pale focal planes against a dark, largely unbroken ground. Deep violet, indigo, and near-black create a subdued body of color, while fine antique-gold linework and tiny jewel-like highlights supply richness. Textiles carry precise repeating ornament and a soft sheen, but exposed surfaces are blended with restrained, almost porcelain transitions. Gentle upper-side light lifts one half of the composition and lets the other recede into shadow without hard theatrical contrast. Formal posture and carefully weighted symmetry keep the frame still. The overall effect is refined, courtly, and materially sumptuous.
style_prompt_zh: 图像具有细密的古典大师油画完成面，平滑塑形的浅亮焦点平面立于大块未被打断的深色底前。深紫、靛蓝与近黑构成低调主体，细古金线与宝石般的小亮点增添丰富度。织物承载精确重复装饰和柔软光泽，裸露表面则以克制、近乎瓷质的过渡融合。柔和上方侧光抬亮构图一半，让另一半退入阴影，却没有坚硬的舞台反差。正式姿态与精心分配的对称让画面静止。整体效果精致、有宫廷气息，材质丰盛。
theme_en: A young noblewoman in embroidered violet dress and jeweled headpiece
theme_zh: 年轻贵族女子身穿紫色刺绣衣裙、佩戴珠饰头冠
name: Bronzino
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
